value.title: The Strange Mouse Cursor
value.synopsis: During IT class, Takumi notices that his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen. He asks his childhood friend Mone, who's sitting next to him, if she can see it, but she can't and just makes fun of him… Assuming she can't see it, Takumi slips the cursor into the gap in Mone's clothes and starts clicking on her body! As he continues clicking on Mone, who's writhing in pleasure from this unfamiliar sensation, the words "The Real Deal" eventually appear in the right-click menu… Huh? "The Real Deal", is that what I think it is?!

value.title: Error: Insufficient Click Point
value.synopsis: As a result of continuously clicking on Mone in the nurse's office, the unthinkable happens with "The Real Deal" appearing in the right-click menu! Takumi instinctively clicks it, but what appeared next was a strange error message reading, "Insufficient click points." His dream of "The Real Deal" ends in failure… On top of that, the possibility suddenly arose that Kaoru, a mysterious girl in his class, might have witnessed the whole thing! Driven by anxiety, Takumi tails Kaoru—but what awaited him was an unexpected turn of events?!

value.title: Cut and Paste
value.synopsis: The 'Real Deal' feature finally activates! Pushed down by Kaoru, who had become even more aggressive than before, Takumi finds himself drowning in pleasure. The next day, faced with Mone's usual bossy attitude, Takumi launches another click attack! But her tie is in the way, preventing him from moving the cursor inside her clothes. Takumi selects 'Cut' for the tie from the right-click menu, but… Called over by a suspicious Mone, Takumi ends up treating her injury by chance. However, he was in for a surprise!

value.title: The Love Accelerator
value.synopsis: Suddenly, Kaoru invites Takumi out on his day off. Could this be… a date? They meet up and go see a movie Kaoru picked out, but… Huh? Wait, whoa… this is pretty adult-oriented… I mean, it's kind of a racy movie!! Flustered by Kaoru's relentless teasing, Takumi once again fights back with mouse cursor clicks! And the newly unlocked feature is Double Sensitivity Mode?! Kaoru is unable to contain her excitement any longer, and…!
